description: Tests what the person who runs it, and an optional coworker, can do on a SharePoint site, and what they can do with the office mailbox. Creates TEST objects, then deletes them; sends 3 test mails to the person who runs it, waits 2 minutes and reads how they arrived (no addresses kept). Records status codes, permission masks and license names only, no names.

text.title: Site address
text.description: Copy it from the browser: everything up to and including the site name

text_1.title: Coworker e-mail (optional)
text_1.description: A regular site member. If empty, R11 and R12 fail; that is expected

text_2.title: Wing group e-mail (optional)
text_2.description: The group that gives wing members access. If empty, R13 fails; that is expected

text_3.title: Office mailbox e-mail (optional)
text_3.description: The office's shared mailbox. If empty, E02-E05 fail; that is expected
